title: mini-doodle - business metrics
description: SCOPE-3 hand-written metrics: booking.attempts, booking.duration, freebusy.query.window.days, outbox.lag.

panels.title: Booking attempts (rate by result)
panels.description: booking_attempts_total{result=success|conflict|not_found} - one line per outcome of POST /bookings. A conflict/not_found spike unrelated to a success spike is the signal that something is wrong upstream of the database (stale slot ids, clients racing on the same slot), not just noise absorbed by the 409/404.

panels.title: Booking duration (p50 / p95)
panels.description: booking_duration_seconds_bucket - latency of POST /bookings end to end (exclusion-constraint conflicts included). p95 pulling away from p50 is the early warning for lock contention before it shows up as user-visible timeouts.

panels.title: Free/busy query window (days requested)
panels.description: freebusy_query_window_days_bucket - distribution of GET /availability window sizes, recorded before the 90-day cap (TECH-7) is enforced, so rejected oversized windows still show up here. A cluster pressing against the cap is the signal to reconsider the limit, not just a 400 in the logs.

panels.title: Outbox lag
panels.description: outbox_lag (seconds) - age of the oldest unpublished outbox_events row, refreshed every OutboxPublisher tick. Near-zero and flat is healthy; a sustained climb means the publisher has stopped draining (crashed, DB unreachable) while writes keep landing - the primary signal that the outbox side of INFRA-3 is stuck.
